## What changed

**1. `Floor` instantiation** — `Floor class>>withRooms:pricedAt:` is the single creation funnel: it runs `assertIsValidNumberOfRooms:` and `assertIsValidPriceList:` (both class side), builds the rooms and sends the only `initialize` message, `initializeWithRooms:pricedAt:`, which just assigns. `setNumberOfRooms:`/`setPrices:` are gone, so a `Floor` cannot be created half-built. Tests' `createFloorWith:and:` now delegates to it.

**2. `Hotel` creation** — `Hotel class>>withFloors:` asserts it has floors and sends `initializeWithFloors:`. `setFloors:` and the `availableRoomsCount` cache are gone; `totalRoomsAvailable` is now derived, so it can no longer drift from reality.

**3–4. Room states** — new `RoomState` hierarchy: `AvailableRoomState`, `ReservedRoomState`, `OccupiedRoomState` (the last one knows the guest type). `nil` and `#reserved` are gone. A state answers the state the room becomes (`AvailableRoomState>>receive:` → `OccupiedRoomState occupiedBy: aGuestType`), so `Room>>receive:`, `#receiveWithReservation:` and `#reserve` are each one line, `state := state <message>`, with no repeated guard. The error cases live once in `RoomState`, which signals `Room signalRoomIsNotEmpty` / `signalRoomIsNotReserved`.

**5–6. Encapsulation** — `Floor>>rooms` is removed. `Floor` answers `receive:atRoom:`, `receiveWithReservation:atRoom:`, `reserveRoom:` and `roomAt:`, and `Room>>lossUsing:ifAbsentGuestType:` is added (available → the highest price, otherwise nothing), so `Floor>>totalLosses` is now the mirror of `totalProfits`. `RoomTest` 13–15 run for real without `shouldFail:`.

One judgment call worth flagging: since `Floor` is the one that indexes rooms, I moved `roomNumberDoesNotExistErrorDescription`/`signalRoomNumberDoesNotExist` from `Hotel` to `Floor` and updated `HotelTest` 09/11/13 to expect `Floor roomNumberDoesNotExistErrorDescription`. The message text is unchanged.

**7. Repetition** — the three `Hotel` guest messages are one liner sends to `(self floorAt: aFloorNumber)`; the four totals plus profits and losses are `floors sum: [ :floor | floor ... ]`; `isEmpty` is `floors allSatisfy: [ :floor | floor isAvailable ]`. All the `whileTrue:` index loops are gone.

**8. Bonus** — tests no longer reach into `floor rooms`, `assert:equals:` now reads actual-then-expected, exception blocks hold a single send and take `:anError`, `FloorTest` uses `minPriceInList`/`maxPriceInList` instead of repeating literals, and `HotelTest` got `createHotelWithASingleFloor`, `assertAllRoomsAreAvailableIn:` and `assertOnlyOneRoomIsReservedIn:`. I also added `FloorTest>>test10CannotReserveARoomThatDoesNotExist` to cover the room lookup error where it now lives.

The test classes were moved to the `ISW1-2024-1C-Parcial-Tests` category (the model stays in `ISW1-2024-1C-Parcial`); both belong to the `ISW1` package, which has no file name set, so nothing was written to disk. Tell me if you want me to save the image or give the package a file to write to.
